Khadirarishta
Are acne breakouts and sensitive skin troubling you? Hiding these under concealers is only going to exacerbate the skin’s vulnerability. If you have sensitive skin, using your favorite cosmetics could cause skin redness, burning sensation, irritation, or dryness and even worsen acne outbreaks. Having acne is distressing, but having it with sensitive skin is even more challenging. Have you considered what could be the root cause of all this? The real culprit could be the accumulated blood toxins. Vitiated blood increases the likelihood of skin inflammation and dysfunctional your skin’s protective barrier. Using topical skin products alone may not achieve the desired result when toxins thrive in your blood. Kerala Ayurveda Khadirarishta is a one-stop solution for acne and sensitive skin issues. This herbal tonic is a powerful combination of blood-purifying and skin-rejuvenating herbs like Cutch tree or Khadira, Himalayan cedar or Devadaru, Purple Fleabane or Bakuchi, Three dried fruits or Triphala, Fire flame bush or Dhataki, Honey, and Rock Sugar. It helps to detoxify your blood and gives acne-free, plump skin.
